quarry.prompt: Dawn over an open-pit quartz quarry cut into wide stepped terraces of white and pale grey rock, a soft pink and gold sky, a dirt road winding down; empty space on the middle terrace on the right for a machine.
quarry.variant: a little dust drifts in the air and the dawn light is a shade warmer

belt.prompt: A macro close-up at the height of a small pebble: a rubber conveyor belt running left to right, covered with chunky white quartz gravel, each pebble large in the picture, the steel side of the belt in front, a big crushing machine only a dark blurred shape far behind, morning light.
belt.variant: the gravel has moved along the belt a little

pebble.prompt: A macro close-up on a bed of grey and white gravel, soft dawn light from the left, a smooth flat spot in the lower middle where a small character can stand, the rest of the gravel softly out of focus, calm.
pebble.variant: the light is a touch brighter

tumble_1.pose: tumbling forward on its side, arms out holding hands with the two red oxygen twins who tumble with it, all three surprised; the two oxygen twins look exactly like the two small red balls in the model sheet, perfectly round and smooth

tumble_2.pose: rolled halfway over, lying on its back with its feet up, face looking up, still holding hands with the two red oxygen twins, all three wide-eyed; the two oxygen twins look exactly like the two small red balls in the model sheet, perfectly round and smooth

tumble_3.pose: on its other side mid-tumble, still holding hands with the two red oxygen twins, all three dizzy; the two oxygen twins look exactly like the two small red balls in the model sheet, perfectly round and smooth

tumble_4.pose: landing upright with a little bounce, still holding hands with the two red oxygen twins, all three dizzy and laughing; the two oxygen twins look exactly like the two small red balls in the model sheet, perfectly round and smooth

present.pose: standing between its two red oxygen twins, holding hands with both, all three facing us and smiling, presenting themselves

proud.pose: standing between its two red oxygen twins, holding hands with both, chest puffed out, mouth wide open shouting proudly

machines.dig_1: A yellow cartoon excavator digger, side view facing left, its long arm raised high with the bucket empty
machines.dig_2: The same yellow excavator, its arm down low, the bucket scooping into white rock
machines.dig_3: The same yellow excavator, its arm swung up, the bucket tipping white rock out
